title: Dependency declared with a v-prefixed version
description: package.json declares a version written with a `v` prefix, which is a tag name rather than a semantic version. npm resolves the text as a dist-tag or rejects it, so the install depends on what the registry happens to have tagged rather than on the version the review saw.
remediation: Write the semantic version without the prefix.
limitation: It matches a version written with a `v` prefix, which is a tag name rather than a semantic version in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
